info.name: nextvolunteers API
info.description: Smoke tests for the NestJS API (see the plan's Verification section). Run the whole collection, or a folder, with the Collection Runner. Requests run in order and pass ids along through collection variables. Start the API first: npm run dev:api

request.description: Timestamped email so the collection can be re-run. Saves userId and userEmail for later requests.

exec: pm.test("409 Conflict on duplicate email", () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
